What certifications do you have?

How much is a protective case?

Reference retail prices: PP small USD 12-22, PP medium USD 22-45, ABS medium USD 30-60, GF-PP medium USD 50-90, rotomold large USD 90-220. Custom adds 30-80%. Wholesale 500+ pcs 30% off.

How to choose a protective case?

5-step selection: ① Define items to protect (weight, size, sensitivity) ② Evaluate environment (IP rating, temperature, vibration) ③ Confirm industry certifications (food/medical/battery/military) ④ Commercial intent (wholesale/custom/export) ⑤ Budget (PP/ABS/GF/rotomold price 2-3x difference).

Core differences between MIL-SPEC and regular cases?

MIL-SPEC cases pass 15+ MIL-STD-810G tests: drop 1.2m+, vibration 25G, salt spray 96h, fungus 28 days, temp shock -40~+70°C. Regular cases only pass IEC 60529 IP rating. Lifespan difference 5-10x.
